description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger An ally within 30 feet becomes frightened.

You'll never quite understand why non-atraxids find your appearance unsettling, but at this point you're used to it. You're adept at using subtle body language to keep others calm, which comes in handy when your friends are frightened due to any source. The value of your ally's frightened condition is reduced by 1.
